stories.title: Menace russe, prix des carburants, présidentielle 2027 : ce qu’il faut retenir de l’interview d’Emmanuel Macron sur TF1 et France 2

en.title: Russian threat, fuel prices, 2027 presidential election: key takeaways from Emmanuel Macron's interview on TF1 and France 2
en.summary: Eight months before leaving the Élysée, President Macron gave an interview demonstrating his continued authority over domestic issues and international developments.

stories.title: «Si la base est frappée, que ferons-nous ?» : Mélenchon réclame un vote du Parlement après l’annonce de l’envoi de militaires en Arabie saoudite

en.title: "If the base is struck, what will we do?": Mélenchon demands a parliamentary vote following the announcement of military deployment to Saudi Arabia
en.summary: LFI presidential candidate Mélenchon invoked constitutional procedures to require parliament to vote on sending French troops to Yanbu, Saudi Arabia's main petroleum export terminal on the Red Sea.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron estime que la France pourrait être visée par une attaque russe de drones explosifs comme celle à l’aéroport de Leipzig

en.title: Emmanuel Macron believes France could be targeted by a Russian drone attack similar to the one at Leipzig airport
en.summary: Macron expressed concern that France faces similar risk to Germany, which Berlin attributes to Russia for an explosive drone attack on Leipzig airport in August.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron dément l'existence d'une alerte de la CIA sur une possible attaque de drones russes visant le sud de la France

en.title: Emmanuel Macron denies the existence of a CIA alert regarding a possible Russian drone attack targeting southern France
en.summary: Macron contradicted foreign media reports concerning alleged warnings from U.S. intelligence about Russian drone threats to southern France.

stories.title: "Vraie menace" de la Russie, taxes sur les carburants, moyens militaires en Arabie saoudite… Ce qu'il faut retenir de l'interview d'Emmanuel Macron sur France 2

en.title: "Genuine threat" from Russia, fuel taxes, military means in Saudi Arabia… What to remember from Emmanuel Macron's interview on France 2
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron discussed France's diplomatic role in attempting to lower fuel prices during a television interview, also addressing Russia as a threat and military deployment to Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Crise du carburant : Emmanuel Macron annonce l’envoi de « moyens militaires » en Arabie saoudite et n’écarte pas une baisse des taxes

en.title: Fuel crisis: Emmanuel Macron announces sending "military means" to Saudi Arabia and does not rule out a tax reduction
en.summary: During a television interview, the French president stated authorities are taking all measures to prevent shortages and guaranteed supply of diesel, gas, and fuel oil through year-end, while announcing military deployment to Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Macron annonce l’envoi de soldats français en Arabie Saoudite pour protéger le port pétrolier de Yanbu

en.title: Macron announces sending French soldiers to Saudi Arabia to protect the Yanbu oil port
en.summary: The French president announced in a television interview that French military personnel will be deployed to protect Saudi Arabia's Yanbu oil port, damaged by Houthi rebel attacks, without engaging in the conflict.

stories.title: Diomaye Faye sur France 24 : FMI, Macky Sall, Ousmane Sonko… ce qu’il faut retenir de l'interview

en.summary: Senegal's president Bassirou Diomaye Faye discussed his break with Ousmane Sonko, a new IMF agreement, and Macky Sall's candidacy for UN Secretary-General in an exclusive interview conducted in New York.

stories.title: Envoi de militaires en Arabie Saoudite, prix du carburant, réserves énergétiques… Ce qu’il faut retenir de l’interview d’Emmanuel Macron

en.title: Sending military personnel to Saudi Arabia, fuel prices, energy reserves… What to remember from Emmanuel Macron's interview
en.summary: French President Macron discussed military deployment to Saudi Arabia, Middle East and Ukraine conflicts, and energy security in a television interview. He expressed reassurance about fuel shortage risks but offered no commitment on additional fuel subsidies.

stories.title: La France va envoyer des «moyens militaires» pour «protéger» un site énergétique clé en Arabie saoudite

en.title: France to send "military means" to "protect" a key energy site in Saudi Arabia
